FAQ

What you should know

Will I get a fixed rent for every property?

No. We offer a fixed rent only for suitable, approved properties — each one is first assessed by location, price, condition and the project’s rules.

What is the fixed rent calculated from?

From the approved property value, stated exactly in the contract. This value may exclude taxes, fees, sinking fund, or financing costs — the exact base is confirmed before signing.

Do I keep ownership of the property?

Yes. The program is based on a rental and management relationship — ownership is never transferred to us.

Can I use the property myself?

It depends on the program you choose. A purely investment variant limits personal stays; a combined variant lets you agree on a specific number of days for personal use.

What happens if there are no guests?

The rent is set by contract, not by the outcome of individual bookings — we carry the operational risk.

Do I have to buy the property through you?

No. We also assess properties bought elsewhere or already owned.
